cited_by.title: How skin conditions look on dark skin (redness, rashes, rosacea, sunburn)

record.population: 15 Black South Africans (phototypes V and VI) diagnosed with rosacea among 6,700 patients over 8 years
record.finding: Rosacea was rare in this clinic (0.2% of patients). Those with phototype VI mostly had skin-coloured papules; those with phototype V had erythema, telangiectasia and red papules; 10 of 15 (67%) had granulomatous rosacea on histology and 5 (33%) declined a facial biopsy. 5 (33%) were HIV positive and 5 (33%) had used topical steroids, so the group is not a clean picture of rosacea alone. The authors say a high index of suspicion is needed because classic erythema and telangiectasia are hard to discern.
record.note: Small case series; one clinic; 5 of 15 were HIV positive and 5 had used topical steroids.
